access: Hugging Face markdown endpoints were inaccessible via the browser search tool. Read the primary arXiv abstracts and HTML method sections instead; titles and IDs verified.

papers.title: Steering Awareness: Detecting Activation Steering from Within
papers.relevance: Section4.4 and AppendixD.4 fit an affine injection-vector-to-transported-perturbation map on training concepts and evaluate held-out concepts. Distributed transport and affine maps are established prior work. Our small fixed-vector context test does not replicate its trained model awareness or establish that an arbitrary affine matrix is an orthogonal rotation.

papers.title: Forecasting Side Effects of Activation Steering
papers.relevance: Uses ridge propagation from unsteered injection-layer states to readout-layer states, with training-only nested regularization selection, to forecast behavior effects. Our baseline-to-intervention displacement comparison uses a fixed penalty and no behavior outcomes; ridge forecasting is not a novel method claim.

papers.title: Local Linearity of LLMs Enables Activation Steering via Model-Based Linear Optimal Control
papers.relevance: Studies local layer dynamics and layerwise Jacobians for feedback control. A finite-strength persistent intervention cloud map, especially with recurrent/KV effects, does not identify those local derivatives or yield its tracking guarantees.

papers.title: FishBack: Pullback Fisher Geometry for Optimal Activation Steering in Transformers
papers.relevance: Uses the output softmax Fisher metric pulled back through intervening Jacobians. Euclidean residual distance preservation/distortion is a different observation; our traces do not measure this metric or demonstrate optimal behavioral steering.

papers.title: Spherical Steering: Geometry-Aware Activation Rotation for Language Models
papers.relevance: Constructs a norm-preserving intervention that rotates individual hidden-state directions toward a contrastive prototype. That input-dependent construction differs from testing whether one shared rigid map describes downstream effects of additive steering. Rotation-based intervention methods already exist.

novelty_boundary: No claim that steering detection, rotation, affine propagation, Jacobians or geometric steering were previously unknown. Any finding here is an exploratory empirical characterization of observed paired activation changes under the specified frozen generator and intervention.
